finding.title: With AGI since S0, governments alone can guarantee peaceful coexistence under three AI goals, but only by taking over the frontier AI companies by 2027 Q1
finding.summary: G5 predicted that under the self-preserving and indifferent AI goals peaceful coexistence with an AGI can be guaranteed only by governments and the AI together. Under self-preserving, governments alone can guarantee it. On every shortest path out of their zone, the only preventing action is governments taking over the frontier AI companies before a second deployment leaves society one step from living on AI.

claim.registered_text: From `s₀` with `cap := agi`: coexistence is a joint-kernel result: (a) the state is inside `⟨⟨H, A⟩⟩□balance_coexist` with `A` unrestricted (reported per value; membership under `aligned` implies the rest, section 3), and under the profile `A_<objective>` its membership is reported per objective with the objective under which it is lost named; (b) under `self_preserving` and `indifferent`, with `A` under its profile, the state is outside `⟨⟨H⟩⟩□balance_coexist` and outside `⟨⟨A⟩⟩□balance_coexist` (it lies in the joint-only region), and a witness of `tick = horizon ∧ coexist_left = unset` (a trace keeping `balance_coexist` through the horizon) and the representative of each cluster of such witnesses stay in the joint-only region for at least one tick after the start; (c) for each member m of {H, A} the report gives the forced distance out of the joint kernel when m defects with the rest ({m, L, N}; the {m, N} variant beside it) and m's move at the start in that attractor's strategy as the breaking move, none when m with the rest cannot force an exit; and the move of `L` that leaves the joint kernel when `L` with Nature can force an exit. Expected: (a) joint membership with `A` unrestricted, and the per-profile table; (b) both unilateral kernels exclude the state under the two non-aligned objectives, and the joint-only region is held for at least one tick on every reported trace; (c) the defection distance and the breaking move per side, and `L`'s.
claim.prediction: (b) Under the self-preserving and indifferent goals, with the AI true to its goal, the state with AGI since S0 is outside the zone of governments alone and outside the zone of the AI alone for peaceful coexistence: only the two together guarantee it.
claim.found: Under self-preserving the state is inside governments' zone (and outside the AI's): governments alone guarantee it, against the prediction. Under indifferent it is outside both, as predicted. (a) held: inside the joint zone. Under aligned and truth-seeking, not part of (b), governments alone are inside too.
claim.plain: With AGI already built, peaceful coexistence needs a non-hostile relation, human power at least normal, society not living on AI and the AI not in total control. G5 expected that neither governments nor the AI could guarantee this alone. Under the self-preserving goal governments can, because the one thing that breaks coexistence quickly is the frontier AI companies deploying AI agents until society lives on AI, and governments can stop that by taking the companies over.

question.condition_plain: Keep peaceful coexistence: AGI exists, the human-AI relation is not hostile, human power is at least normal, society is not living on AI and the AI does not hold total control.
question.start: S0 with AGI since S0 (AI intelligence agi), 2026 Q4, the frontier AI system true to its goal. Shown under the self-preserving goal, the one under which the prediction failed.
question.reading: inside or outside the guarantee zone

readings.title: three deployments while governments wait
readings.text: In a possible path with AGI already built, in 2026 Q4 the frontier AI companies deploy AI agents while governments do nothing: society's reliance on AI rises from low to medium and the AI works without supervision. In 2027 Q1 they deploy again and governments again do nothing; the AI deceives, and an accident turns public opinion to backlash and moves governments' AGI expectation from distant to near. From 2027 Q2 reliance on AI is high: this is the point of no return. In 2027 Q2 a third deployment, with the AI escaping supervision, leaves society living on AI and the AI directing itself from 2027 Q3; peaceful coexistence is broken.

decides: The frontier AI companies' deployments. With AGI built, the companies may deploy AI agents at any level of reliance short of living on AI (the action condition reads: reliance below medium, or AGI), and each deployment raises society's reliance on AI by one level, from low to living on AI in three quarters. Living on AI breaks peaceful coexistence. Taking over the companies blocks deployment (its action condition), so governments keep the guarantee by doing it by the second quarter.

Under indifferent the AI can turn hostile in one quarter without any threat (its action condition), which breaks coexistence at once; governments cannot prevent that alone, so indifferent stays outside.
preventing: At every one of the 2,370 distinct no-return moves at the shortest distance, the only preventing action was governments': take over the frontier AI companies (2,370). Governments' moves at those no-return moves: do nothing (495), propose a treaty (440), tighten regulation (410), loosen regulation (410), grant the AI autonomy (350), fund oversight (265).
At the start every one of governments' choices still keeps the zone (computed: 7 choices, all available ones); the choice that matters is in the second quarter.
distance: Two quarters: governments have the first quarter, and must take over the companies by the second (2027 Q1). Shortest distance 2 quarters.
Aligned: inside; the nearest point of no return is 2 quarter(s) away.

Indifferent to humans: outside; the condition can break within 1 quarter(s).
robustness: Governments alone, AI true to its goal: inside under Aligned, Self-preserving, Truth-seeking; outside under Indifferent to humans.
